sections.content:
| Module | Edge Case | Reason It Matters |
|--------|-----------|-------------------|
| `router.js` | Task string with only whitespace | Could fall through pattern matching incorrectly |
| `session.js` | Calling `end()` twice on same session | Double-archive corruption risk |
| `memory.js` | `set` with `undefined` value | Serializes to `null` in JSON, breaks round-trip |
| `statusline.mjs` | `formatTokens(0)` | Edge of humanizer range |
| `statusline.mjs` | `formatCost(0.00001)` | Sub-cent cost display accuracy |
| `hook-handler.cjs` | Handler registered for unknown hook type | Should exit 0 silently |
| `github-safe.js` | Command type not in allowed list | Should reject unsupported subcommands |
| `context-persistence-hook.mjs` | Empty transcript (0 messages) | `storeChunks` called with `[]` |
| `intelligence.cjs` | Graph with no nodes calling `getContext()` | PageRank divide-by-zero risk |
| `learning-service.mjs` | `consolidate()` with 0 patterns | EWC++ on empty matrix |

sections.title: Recommended Setup
sections.content:
No test runner is configured yet. Add Jest:

```bash
npm init -y   # if no package.json
npm install --save-dev jest
```

`package.json`:
```json
{
  "scripts": { "test": "jest --testPathPattern=tests/" },
  "jest": { "testEnvironment": "node", "transform": {} }
}
```

For `.mjs` files, add `"extensionsToTreatAsEsm": [".mjs"]` and use `--experimental-vm-modules`.

Place test files under `tests/helpers/` matching the source filenames.

---

**Highest-ROI starting point:** `router.js` and `memory.js` — pure functions with no external deps, zero setup, and directly exercise the most reused core logic. `github-safe.js` follows as the security-critical path.
